notes: Printed line below the table, kept inside the region: 'P.E.-population equivalent as design flow divided by per capita sewage flow.'
This table repeats the caption of Table 6.11 word for word ('Sludge source and volume/population equivalent') with different values and a different unit heading; both captions are printed as shown.
Unit heading here is 'm³/(P.E.)' against '(m³/P.E.)' in Table 6.11. Kept as printed.
No (A) footnote marker and no Note line appear on this table; only the P.E. definition is printed.
Storage values are three-decimal (0.004, 0.002, 0.003) against the two-decimal values of Table 6.11. Kept as printed.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of the full 144 dpi annotation-cleaned page PNG plus a 320 dpi crop of the table, caption and P.E. definition; earlier sew-t08 draft re-read and retained. No OCR, no paid service, no delegation.
transcription.observations: First reading only (recovery batch). Caption, header, all three rows and the P.E. line checked against the image; unit prints as "m³/(P.E.)" here and as "(m³/P.E.)" in Table 6.11. Retained as printed. No distinct second visual pass and no verification seal.
